flags: Closure: NPS's Floyd Bennett Field page (last updated September 30, 2026) says 'The Floyd Bennett Field campsite and campstore remain closed at this time.' No reopening date. Recreation.gov has no inventory loaded for any month checked (Jul 2023, Jul 2024, Jul 2025, Jul 2026, May-Jul 2027) while Sandy Hook's facility shows July 2026 bookings, and NPS's Camping at Gateway page (updated 2026-03-31) lists only Sandy Hook. Recorded as temporarily_closed; it has been closed at least three seasons (the field hosted the city's migrant shelter 2023-2025), so a reviewer may judge it closed for good.

Fees: the $30 rests only on recreation.gov's rate table, whose seasons are dated 2019 and 2020 ('Peak 2019-05-17 to 2019-10-19', '2020-06-01 to 2020-09-21', RV NONELECTRIC $30); no 2024+ rate for this campground was found (NPS's 2026 Gateway rates page covers Sandy Hook only).

Phone: 718-338-3799 is the Ryan Visitor Center line, which NPS posts as out of service (alert 2026-06-16: 'The Floyd Bennett Field Ryan Visitor Center phone line (718-338-3799) is out of service ... call the general park information line at 718-354-4606'). Suggest 718-354-4606.

Missing operator website: add NPS's Floyd Bennett Field page https://www.nps.gov/gate/learn/historyculture/floyd-bennett-field.htm (carries the closure statement); the entry has only the recreation.gov link.
